explain.compile: iverilog elaborates RTL + testbench into sim.vvp. One harmless warning: pwm_led inherits the testbench timescale.
explain.run: vvp replays the circuit clock edge by clock edge. The testbench drives clk/rst and checks the hardware at four checkpoints.
explain.window: test2 counts the cycles LED0 is on over 256 clocks, while duty keeps ramping.
explain.fail: LED0 was on 51/256, but the check used duty read after the window (55). The RTL is right; the check is wrong.
explain.fix: Snapshot d0 = dut.duty when the window opens; accept d0-2 … duty+2.
explain.pass: Same RTL, fixed testbench: 4/4 PASS. pwm_led.vcd goes to GTKWave next.
